original_text: <!-- (Audio) Maria: What happened? Bob: Well, you mentioned we need 10 pounds of chicken wings, but I thought we agreed on 20 pounds. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Marija: Šta se desilo? Bob: Pa, spomenula si da nam treba 10 funti krilca pilećeg, ali mislio sam da smo se dogovorili za 20 funti. -->
